VSCO 2 Community Edition / Versilian Studios
Creators: Sam Gossner and Simon Dalzell. Additional sample cutting: Elan Hickler / Soundemote.
https://versilian-studios.com/vsco-community/

Source commit: 440300901dfe9275fd84e0b7763af1f8443ae62e
SFZ mapping commit: 6dd651d55dde97fd4028699be9d4481f26917891
manifest.json records every original path, root MIDI note, source SHA-256, processed SHA-256 and loop.

MUSIC ROOM browser adaptation (not the complete upstream library):
24 banks, 180 selected recordings; one dynamic layer and no round robin.
Mono PCM16, source sample rate (44.1 or 48 kHz), normalized peak 0.8.
Trimmed initial silence and length (sustained instruments <=5s, one-shots <=9s).
180ms crossfade loops for sustained instruments; 20ms end fades.
Root notes come from upstream SFZ pitch_keycenter, never inferred from file octave spelling.
Upstream SFZ maps are used for pitch information; this browser is not an SFZ interpreter.
Instrument ranges shown in the UI are composition guidance, not restrictions on transposition.
Preparation: tools/prepare-orchestra.mjs. Samples are served locally; there is no runtime CDN.
